interpretation.tracking: time-aligned error includes dynamic lag, not necessarily static error
interpretation.wbc_alignment: unstamped vectors matched by callback arrival <=25ms
interpretation.force: raw joint_torque is simulation qfrc_actuator per publisher source; tau is requested torque; tau_max is not treated as Nm
interpretation.fk: URDF FK difference, same base frame; not an independent end-effector measurement
interpretation.visual: outer residual variation includes intended visual trajectory changes; not pure corrective motion or vision compute
interpretation.plateau: 1s command and WBC reference ranges <=0.003rad and measured speed <=0.03rad/s

joint_bound_definition.source: runtime URDF limits, not QP active flags
